# healthcare-devices

Medical device interoperability: ISO/IEEE 11073 PHD/SDC, IHE PCD and device-to-EHR integration via HL7 v2 or FHIR.

Install: `copilot plugin install healthcare-devices@healthcare-copilot` (see the repository README).
